blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu Archbishop Alberto Uy has urged Catholic faithful and people of goodwill in the archdiocese to sign a citizens’ petition to enact a law to prohibit political dynasties. Archbishop Uy pointed his flock to the measure introduced by the multisectoral group Dapat 1sa Lang, which uses the 1987 Constitution’s guidelines for citizen lawmaking through a people’s initiative and referendum. “Following the lead of the Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines, the Archdiocese of Cebu expresses its support for the ‘Dapat Isa Lang’ People’s Initiative, a peaceful, lawful, and democratic effort toward the enactment of an anti-political dynasty law,” […]...
